task_description: Replace the failing folder-pick + session-long security scope architecture in the Continuum iOS host with an Import-and-Copy Library, like Delta and Provenance, on branch ps1-pcsx-rearmed. Four parts: (1) reconfigure UIDocumentPickerViewController for FILES with allowsMultipleSelection = true and asCopy: true so a user selects a .cue together with its .bin tracks in one pass; the picker offers [UTType.item] because iOS has no built-in UTType for cue/bin/chd/pbp, and building allowedContentTypes from UTType(filenameExtension:) greys those exact files out, so acceptance is enforced by a post-pick extension filter (cue, bin, chd, pbp, iso) instead. (2) Copy every accepted file into the app's own Documents directory with FileManager.copyItem, preserving the original filename EXACTLY (a .cue references its tracks by name, so renaming silently breaks the game), overwriting on collision, each file in its own do/catch so one failure cannot abort the batch. (3) Build a SwiftUI Library view that scans Documents and lists only launchable entries (cue, chd, pbp, iso) so .bin tracks do not clutter the list, with an Import Games button, a real empty state, and swipe to delete. (4) Launch by tapping a row: the absolute Documents path goes straight to the existing engine.launch(coreId:contentId:rom:filename:) with rom: Data() and the Rust side unchanged, and because the file is inside our own sandbox the whole security-scope machinery (activeScopedURL, failAfterScope, folder scope acquisition, selectLaunchEntry(in:), UTType.folder) is removed. Preserve the hard-won picker infrastructure: the strongly retained delegate on the long-lived @MainActor EngineHost, all four @objc callbacks, the present(_:animated:completion:) HUD line, the topmost-view-controller resolution, the explicit Task { @MainActor } hops, ensureCoreLoaded, the BIOS/HLE line, MetalCanvas wiring, and a distinct HUD string on every failure path. Scope: native/ios/ContinuumApp.swift only. Commit locally; do not push, do not open a PR, do not trigger CI.

verification.summary: All Linux-verifiable gates pass. swiftc -frontend -parse native/ios/ContinuumApp.swift: exit 0 (parse only, no SwiftUI/UIKit type-check available in this sandbox), so the picker init, the four @objc selectors, present(_:animated:completion:), the FileManager copy/remove/enumerate calls, List/ForEach identity via a stable Identifiable model keyed on absolute path, and every @MainActor hop were reviewed by eye. grep proves zero remaining references to activeScopedURL, failAfterScope, selectLaunchEntry, LaunchEntryOutcome, UTType.folder and startAccessingSecurityScopedResource outside the single defensive balanced pair in the import loop; exactly one engine.launch call site remains. cargo test: 74 passed, 0 failed (Rust untouched). project.yml and Info.plist needed no change (UIFileSharingEnabled and LSSupportsOpeningDocumentsInPlace were already present in both) and were re-validated with yaml.safe_load and plistlib anyway. Only native/ios/ContinuumApp.swift plus the .agents/tasks plan files are modified. The .ipa build and on-device import/launch cannot run here (no macOS, Xcode or iOS SDK) and are verified only by the orchestrator's CI and device run afterward.
